description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-TYPE, SQL-AGG-SINGLE: For the Decimal field of FD, what do Avg, Var and StDev return (type, value, or error and call) per group 1 to 8 (one statement per group and aggregate family), what do Min, Max and Count give as GROUP BY g, and what do Sum(x * 1), Sum(CDec(x)), Sum(CCur(x)) and Sum(CDbl(x)) give for groups 1, 2, 4 and 5? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
